title: Unnamed settlement between Guerria and Meğana
description: Remains of an ancient settlement of Roman date, recorded by Gsell (AAA, whence BAtlas). The location should lie within 2 km of the BAtlas coordinates: a point near modern Guerria and the modern road from Guerria to Meğana in the Algerian wilaya of Bordj Bou Arreridj.

properties.description: Coordinates extracted using QGIS from a raster image of Barrington Atlas Map 31 that was georegistered to OpenStreetMap using prominent, stable landscape features. Dates after BAltDir.
properties.title: BAtlas Point Location
